governor budget.3: HARDEN — burn-rate over tolerance; stop the line

pawl review.5: HOLD / UNAVAILABLE — strict quorum could not run at two-family strength

plan-pawl decide.5: DEGRADED — transient panel lane loss below quorum; retry the panel

verify.0: CONFIRMED — verdict written and bound to the commit
verify.3: REFUTED — defects printed; fix and re-run
verify.5: HOLD / UNAVAILABLE — committed policy is invalid or strict quorum cannot run at two-family strength
